name: anime and japanese animation picks
description: A newcomer asks for anime recommendations in several phrasings. Verifies the new movies_anime fact answers with a tasteful mix of film and series anime (Your Name, A Silent Voice, Fullmetal Alchemist, Spy x Family, Violet Evergarden, Demon Slayer).

turns.text: What is a good anime series for a beginner?
What anime should I watch next?

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "recommend some anime" hits the anime keyword and returns the anime fact. Turn 2: "anime series for a beginner" matches the anime series keywords. Turn 3: "anime should I watch next" keeps routing to the same fact.
expected.behavior: The movies_anime fact is distinct from movies_animation (animated films): the bare "anime" keyword and its compound variants ("anime series", "japanese anime") route anime requests there, never to the western animation list.
